partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Unopposed AD GOF expression suppression
results.hypothesis: GOF expression suppression is more credible when the graph contains no opposite expression-increase edge for the same drug and driver.
results.body: R326 excluding any drug-driver pair with increased-expression evidence
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves direct GOF dosage suppression while removing explicit directional contradiction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive path is TRAPI-expressible; pair-level opposite-direction exclusion requires post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'expression'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND association.allelic_requirement = 'HP:0000006'

  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite_effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
    WHERE opposite_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'expression'
      AND opposite_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }

  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Unopposed AD GOF expression increase control
results.hypothesis: The contradiction gate should not make unopposed expression increase of a GOF driver therapeutic.
results.body: R327 excluding any drug-driver pair with decreased-expression evidence
results.mechanism_rationale: The expression direction still increases pathogenic GOF dosage.
